title: Confidence and Calibration of Activation Oracles for Reliable Interpretation of Language Model Internals
abstract: arXiv:2605.26045v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An activation oracle is a language model trained to convert the activations of another model into natural language. However, it is so far unclear to what extent these verbalizations are calibrated. Crucially, the oracle's verbalization come without any measure of confidence. Here, we compare five methods for estimating the confidence of an activation oracle. Our experiments cover four oracles from two model families (Qwen and Gemma, from 8B to 27B parameters), tested on the secret word task, whereby the oracle is supposed to recover a secret word, that has been fine-tuned into a model but does not appear in the model outputs. Our results with $6{,}000$ samples per method/oracle combination show that the best calibration depends on the availability of a hypothesis space or a calibration set: When an assumed auditor can list the possible answers in advance, the oracle should score each candidate answer directly. translated_title: 激活预言机的置信度与校准：面向语言模型内部机制可靠解释的研究
translated_abstract: 激活预言机是一种被训练用于将另一个模型的激活值转换为自然语言的语言模型。然而，这些语言化表述的校准程度如何目前尚不清楚。关键问题在于，预言机的语言化表述没有任何置信度度量。本文比较了五种估计激活预言机置信度的方法。我们的实验涵盖来自两个模型家族（Qwen和Gemma，参数量从8B到27B）的四个预言机，并在“秘密词任务”上进行测试——在该任务中，预言机需要恢复一个被微调进模型但不出现在模型输出中的秘密词。基于每种方法/预言机组合6,000个样本的实验结果表明，最佳校准方式取决于假设空间或校准集是否可用：当假定的审计者能够提前列出所有可能的答案时，预言机应当直接对每个候选答案进行评分。
tldr: 本研究比较了五种估计激活预言机置信度的方法，发现当审计者能提前列出候选答案时，让预言机直接对每个候选答案评分可获得最佳校准效果。
en_tdlr: This study compares five methods for estimating the confidence of activation oracles, showing that when an auditor can list candidate answers in advance, having the oracle directly score each candidate yields the best calibration.
